status.explanation: Held-out agreement checks passed, but no valid-observation coverage was available, so differences in cloud/swath coverage are absorbed into the ratio (confounded). Use as an exploratory estimate only.

model.name: seasonal_ratio
model.label: Paired conditional rate-ratio model (seasonal + land cover)

proportionality.meaning: Change in log(source/reference ratio) per unit log(paired detections). Non-zero means the ratio depends on fire size/activity, so a constant-ratio conversion is biased at extremes.

drift.meaning: Trend of the log ratio across the overlap. A significant trend means transferring the calibration outside the overlap period is unsafe.

zero_check.note: Not assessable: without valid-observation coverage, zero cell-weeks cannot be distinguished from unobserved ones.

warnings: Significant drift of the sensor ratio across the overlap: transfer outside the overlap is unreliable.
The sensor ratio depends on activity level: constant-ratio conversion may be biased for very large or very small events.
No valid-observation coverage: coverage differences between platforms are absorbed into the ratio, and zero weeks cannot be distinguished from unobserved weeks.
harmonization.target: Aqua-equivalent quality-filtered detections per week (coverage assumed comparable between platforms)
